public_rationale: Zitron guessed the Abilene diesel permit was for emergency backup, and that OpenAI and SoftBank would not run the site mainly on diesel. Crusoe's March 2025 plan relied on a 1.2 GW grid connection, with gas turbines for backup. By April 2026 the site was running at about 0.3 GW. Epoch AI described its power as a mix of on-site natural gas and grid power, which includes local wind. No source I found shows diesel as the main supply. The forecast held.
limitations: Epoch AI is an independent analyst, not the operator. No primary record breaks down the power mix over time.
The claim was partly a guess about why the permit existed. Only the forecast part is graded.

our_interpretation: Read as a forecast that the Abilene Stargate site would not run on diesel generators as its main power source, including during the gap before conventional power arrived.
No deadline was given. The claim can be settled early once the site is running and its actual power supply is publicly described.
criteria.support_condition: Once the Abilene site is running, credible reports describe its power as coming mainly from the grid and/or on-site natural gas, with diesel used only as backup or not at all.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible reports show the Abilene site ran its compute mainly on diesel generators for any real stretch of operation.
